test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is INCORRECT about line standard?

options.text: More accurate due to line thickness
Used to measure the distance between two engraved lines
Quick measurements over a wide range

solution:
The correct answer is __Option 1**(More accurate due to line thickness)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Line standard__ is a method of measurement using engraved lines.
 
• It is used to measure the distance between two engraved lines.
 
• Line standards provide quick measurements over a wide range.
 
• They are subject to parallax error because of the positioning of the observer.
 
• The statement "More accurate due to line thickness" is incorrect, as line thickness can lead to inaccuracies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **End Standards:**
 
 
• End standards are based on the measurement between two flat surfaces.
 
• They are more precise compared to line standards.
 
 
 
• **Gauge Blocks:**
 
 
• Gauge blocks are used as end standards for calibration and measurement.
 
• They are made from high-grade materials to ensure accuracy.
